## 维护者速读
- 用户暂时看不到变化：这次只做问题卡组件本身（单题点一下就答、两题停在「发送」、自己输入、跳过、键盘和读屏、11 种语言），还没接进对话。
- 属于「问题卡」专题第一段，让 AI 提澄清问题时用户点一下就能回答，接入对话是同专题的下一张卡。
- 出错只影响这张卡本身，目前没有任何页面用到它，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- New `QuestionCard` in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (exported with `QuestionCardProps`, `QuestionCardQuestion`, `QuestionCardOption`): a pure component, questions in, `onAnswer(text)` / `onSkip()` out. Nothing renders it yet; wiring it in the composer's place is #37874 (Q2b).
- One question: a click on an option answers at once. Two questions: an option on question 1 moves to question 2; question 2 never answers on its own, it waits on Send with a one-line summary; Back keeps both choices.
- "Type something else…" is always the last row: a one-line input, typing clears the picked option, Enter moves on or sends. IME composition is ignored.
- Answer text: the label or typed text for one question; one `header: answer` line per question for two (question text when no header). The separator is the `chatbot.questionCard.answerLine` string, so zh-Hans/zh-Hant/ja write a full-width colon and fr its space-before-colon.
- Options show `description` as a grey second line and `recommended` as a "Recommended" tag.
- Keyboard: focus is never moved into the card from outside; while focus is inside, 1–4 pick, ↑/↓ move (options then the text row, wrapping), Ctrl/⌘+Enter moves on or sends. After a move to the next question, focus lands on that question's option (only when the move started inside the card).
- Screen reader: a radiogroup labelled with "Question 1 of 2" and the question, one tab stop on the checked option; `announce` puts "A question is waiting for your answer" into a polite live region the host triggers.
- Size: `max-h-[60vh]`, the body scrolls inside, the button row stays fixed; `className` overrides.
- Choices live in component state and survive a re-render with new props (the retry after a failed send); a new question is a remount with a new `key`.
- Ten `chatbot.questionCard.*` strings in all 11 locale packs (`ar`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` generated from `zh-Hans`); the card sets `dir` from the session language, so Arabic is right-to-left.
- README and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` gain a "Question card" section; changeset `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/QuestionCard.tsx` — `pick` / `advance` / `compose` (the stop-on-send rule and the answer text) and `onKeyDown`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/QuestionCard.test.tsx` — the behaviour pins.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` — one allowlist row for the format string.

## Tests

- `QuestionCard.test.tsx` (21, provider-less): single-click send, description and tag, typed answer and blank refusal, skip, re-render keeps the choice for a retry, two-question flow with summary and Back, Next disabled until answered, typed text on both questions, no focus move on mount, digits / Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter, IME Enter ignored, ↑/↓ wrap, focus kept on page change, roving tab stop, radiogroup name, live region, defaults map equals the `en` pack.
- `QuestionCard.i18n.test.tsx` (3, with provider): zh-Hans strings and the full-width-colon answer, `ar` is `dir="rtl"` and translated, `en` is `ltr`.
- Ablation: making question 2 send on pick reds 2 of 21 (the two-question flow and the digit test); restored.

## Acceptance notes

- The component takes `questions` (the envelope's `questions` array shape: `header?`, `question`, `options[{label, description?, recommended?}]`) rather than a Q1 type, because #37872 (Q1) has not landed. The prop types are structurally the Q1 envelope's question shape, so Q2b can pass `envelope.questions` as is. carrier: #37874.
- One string the card did not list: `answerLine` (`{{header}}: {{answer}}`), so the separator follows each language instead of a hard-coded colon. Its identity with `en` in ko/ru/ar is allowlisted as a format string, the same way `detail.fieldChangeLabel` is.
- `aiAsks` ("AI asks:") is drawn as the card's eyebrow line so the key has a reader here; Q2b may reuse it for the collapsed summary.
- File surface beyond the claim's `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/**` and locale packs: `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` (one allowlist row), `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` (docs, ui AGENTS #2), `.changeset/37873-question-card.md`.
